record.question: Why did you do it? Identify the part of speech of the underlined word.
record.explanation: Answer A: Adverb. “Why” asks the reason for the action and functions as an interrogative adverb. Independent check: “Why” asks the reason for the action and modifies “did … do”; it is an interrogative adverb. Reference: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/wh-questions.
